targets.arm64_apple: partial: scalar integer/floating functions with control flow, memory and direct/indirect register/stack-argument calls

syntax.integer functions and parameters: partial: unquoted ASCII QBE names (including dots/dollar signs), decimal literals, w/l or void result, at most 64 w/l parameters
syntax.basic blocks, jumps, phi: partial: integer/floating SSA and mutable temporaries, jmp/jnz/ret/hlt, loops, dominance and parallel phi transfers
syntax.calls and variadic functions: partial: up to 64 w/l/s/d scalar arguments and scalar/void results; direct/indirect calls, callbacks, env and integer/floating variadics; aggregates and subword ABI remain
syntax.floating point and conversions: partial: IEEE constants/data, s/d arithmetic, comparisons, casts, numeric conversions, memory, phi and scalar ABI; defined-range conversion model and default IEEE execution profile
syntax.memory and allocation: partial: integer loads/stores, loadw/loadl aliases; positive constant/runtime alloc4/8/16 in any block and alloc1/2 aliases; effect-only constant blit copies in 0..4096 bytes for disjoint or identical spans; zero-sized static allocation remains unsupported
syntax.aggregate type and data definitions: partial: packed b/h/w/l/s/d bit-pattern data, z zero fill, alignment 1..64, long symbol relocations with addends, byte strings (UTF-8/common and octal escapes) and data-only modules; aggregate types and remaining linkage forms remain
syntax.linkage, sections, TLS and debug locatio: partial: export for functions/data and global symbol operands; sections, TLS and debug locations remain

passes.parsing and validation: partial: integer/control-flow/memory/integer-call SSA subset; full QBE syntax remains
passes.CFG, dominance and SSA construction: partial: CFG/dominance validation and mutable-temporary SSA construction with on-demand phis; stable types and defined incoming values required
passes.ABI lowering: partial: Apple AArch64 scalar w/l/s/d register/stack arguments and results; independent GP/FP banks, direct/indirect calls, variadics, env and saved live values
passes.liveness, spilling and register allocati: not implemented; baseline gives every value a stack slot
